description: Look up Eligian operations BEFORE calling one you have not used yet: each card starts with NEEDS / PROVIDES / ERASES (the operationData an operation reads, writes and removes), then its parameters, the call form and the description. `names` batches lookups; an unknown name comes back with suggestions. Filters `query` (name contains), `category`, `needs` and `provides` intersect. `kind` lists the other names: `controller` (with status), `event` (timeline events), `dom-event`, `key`. `path` (an .eligian file) adds the host operations, controllers and functions its `extensions` import declares. No argument: the operation names by category. At most 25 cards per call; the rest are named in `notReturned`.
name: eligian_operations
